concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
question: Of which state was Mirza Wajid Ali Shah the king in 1856, when it was annexed into the British Empire in India under the doctrine of lapse policy?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Awadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirza Wajid Ali Shah** was the last **Nawab of Awadh**, a region in present-day **Uttar Pradesh, India**.
 
• In **1856**, Awadh was annexed by the British under the controversial **Doctrine of Lapse**, a policy introduced by **Lord Dalhousie**.
 
• The British accused Wajid Ali Shah of **misgovernance** as a pretext for the annexation, although historians argue it was primarily for strategic and economic reasons.
 
• The annexation of Awadh became a major cause of resentment among the locals and was a contributing factor to the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**.
 
• Wajid Ali Shah was known for his patronage of **art, culture, and music**, and his reign saw the flourishing of **Lucknow's cultural heritage**.
 
• After the annexation, Wajid Ali Shah was exiled to **Calcutta (Kolkata)**, where he spent the remainder of his life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nagpur**__

 __
 
• **Nagpur** was annexed by the British in **1853** under the Doctrine of Lapse after the death of its ruler, **Raghoji III**, who left no heir.
 
• It became part of the **Central Provinces** under British administration.
 
 
 
• **Satara**__
 __
 
• **Satara** was one of the first princely states to be annexed by the British under the Doctrine of Lapse in **1848**.
 
• The last ruler, **Appa Sahib**, died without a male heir, leading to its annexation.
 
 
 
• **Jhansi**__
 
 
• **Jhansi** was also annexed by the British under the Doctrine of Lapse in **1854** after the death of its ruler, **Raja Gangadhar Rao**.
 
• This annexation was fiercely opposed by **Rani Lakshmibai**, who played a key role in the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**.
